redfin.remarks: This beautifully maintained two-level townhome in the heart of Redondo Beach offers the perfect blend of coastal comfort and everyday convenience. Spanning 1,165 sqft, the interior features a unique split-level layout seamlessly connecting the living and dining areas. The home showcases thoughtful upgrades throughout, including rich hardwood floors and durable slate tile flooring in the entryways, kitchen, and bathrooms. The upper level boasts a dual primary setup with a Jack and Jill bathroom layout. The spacious main bedroom functions as a relaxing retreat, complete with soaring cathedral-vaulted ceilings and a private balcony that captures plenty of natural sunlight. On the main floor, a cozy living room fireplace adds warmth to the space and easy access to the private patio for outdoor dining. The standout benefit of this property is its prime South Bay location, which earns an exceptional walker's paradise rating. Situated just one block from Hermosa Beach and a mere mile from the ocean, residents can enjoy daily beach access, stunning sunsets, and refreshing coastal breezes without needing to drive. A short walk from your front door brings you to a vibrant selection of local retail stores, grocery spots, and diverse neighborhood restaurants, making day-to-day errands completely effortless. Families will also appreciate inclusion in the highly regarded Redondo Unified School District, with top-tier schools like Jefferson Elementary located just a half-mile away. Nestled inside a quiet, secure, and highly social 38-unit community, this home provides a peaceful escape from the bustling city. The property includes direct garage access, an individual indoor laundry room, and plentiful visitor parking right in front of the home. The low monthly homeowners association fee delivers excellent value by covering exterior insurance, trash pickup, and grounds maintenance. Best of all, residents gain exclusive access to a beautiful, in-ground community association pool, perfect for cooling off on warm sunny days.
